The '''Snow Hills Pass''', known to the [[Hailstorm Brotherhood]] as the '''White Ridge Hills''', was a roadway that ran along the southern edge of the [[White Maw Pass]] in the [[Glacial Fissure]], between the fissure itself and the [[Crystal Wastes]] to the south, and linked [[Leth Outpost]] to the west with [[Frostwake Outpost]] to the east.<ref name="location" />
